history.description: A deep dawn sky over a low horizon: navy above, a cool blue band, and an amber and ember glow where a softly glowing sun crests. High thin clouds catch the light from below and drift slowly, rays fan out through their gaps, and faint stars fade as the sun comes up.

Layered hills recede toward a sunrise, the farthest nearly lost in haze and the nearest deep ink with a thin warm rim of light. Low mist pools between them and glows gold in the valley where the sun rises, and the hills shift at different rates as the cursor moves.

definitions.name: rise
definitions.description: How far the sun has risen, 0 to 1 (default 1). 0 is pre-dawn: the sun below the horizon, a faint warm glow, dark clouds and visible stars. 1 has the sun about two-thirds up, the clouds lit ember to gold, the valley mist glowing and rays through the cloud gaps. Continuous, so the landing sets it from scroll as the footer comes into view.
